items.headline: Niemann Wins LIV Playoff
items.text: Joaquin Niemann won his eighth LIV Golf title by beating Talor Gooch in a playoff at LIV Golf Korea as LIV seeks new funding after Saudi PIF ended support after 2026.

items.headline: Potgieter's Bogey-Free Streak
items.text: Louisiana's Malan Potgieter extended his bogey-free streak to 91 holes at the NCAA Championship, breaking the NCAA record and nearing Tiger Woods’ professional mark of 110 consecutive bogey-free holes.
